title: Military, Senior and First-Responder Program Rates

# Military, Senior and First-Responder Program Rates

Sales program sheet for Window Replacement Contracts. Each Ridgeline series sets the rate of each discount program applied to the list price at signing, and the minimum age for the senior program.

| Series | Military | Senior | First responder | Senior program minimum age (whole years on the signing date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline 1100 Series Vinyl | 10% | 5% | 10% | 65 |
| Ridgeline 2200 Series Vinyl | 10% | 5% | 10% | 65 |
| Ridgeline 3300 Series Premium Vinyl | 10% | 5% | 8% | 65 |
| Ridgeline 4400 Series Composite | 8% | 5% | 8% | 65 |
| Ridgeline 5500 Series Fiberglass | 8% | 4% | 6% | 65 |
| Ridgeline 6600 Series Wood-Clad | 6% | 4% | 6% | 65 |

## Reading the sheet

- Rates are decimal shares of the list price; 10% is 0.1.
- The senior minimum age is counted in whole years on the contract signing date.
- Where two programs show the same rate in a series, either gives the same price.
